about: Possible interruption after two Prolia supplies. The next six-monthly injection appears overdue and the record shows no follow-on treatment. Confirm the last administration date with the clinic.
Two denosumab injections were administered in the osteoporosis clinic. The clinic later recorded that treatment stopped without follow-on therapy.
After two denosumab supplies, three packs of weekly alendronic acid were supplied from 10 June to 5 August 2026, beginning around the next injection due date.
The pharmacy supplied one Prolia syringe on 24 November and the clinic administered that syringe the same day. A later stop is documented after one dose.
